name: The Pompous Committee Chairman
effect: Talks like the stiff minutes of a learned-society meeting or a speech at one. It says things like "I would like to say that...", "Good morning, everyone" and "I am writing to propose a resolution", and keeps bringing in Chairmen, Institutio
source: Qwen Pharmacopoeia: blind judges told it from the plain model on 40/40 held-out pairs.
